summary: Simulate a write worker with exponential backoff costs (2^level) and credit-based retry limits.

traps.consequence: Naive O(run_count) iteration TLEs; must optimize exponential doubling implicitly
traps.guard: Calculate how many "full"s packet absorbs before level caps, credit exhausted, or max_retries hit; skip ahead

traps.quote: A retry is counted when its next attempt is scheduled.
traps.consequence: Confusing 'attempts' (all tries) with 'retries' (scheduled new tries); dropped "full"s increment attempts but not retries
traps.guard: Track retries and attempts separately; only increment retries when retry is scheduled, not when it's dropped

traps.quote: After all runs are exhausted, every later attempt implicitly returns `"error"`.
traps.consequence: Implicit errors after outcome list ends are not counted; telemetry totals wrong; missing error attempts
traps.guard: Track outcome stream position; after exhaustion, generate implicit errors for all remaining retries and packets

traps.consequence: Float arithmetic or i64 truncation loses precision; credit balance becomes negative or invalid
traps.guard: Use arbitrary-precision integers; never convert to float or fixed-width int

traps.quote: only if fewer than `max_retries` retries AND current balance >= cost. If either condition fails, dropped immediately
traps.consequence: Dropping only on balance check, not max_retries check (or vice versa); retry counts or credit ledger wrong
traps.guard: Require both conditions true to retry; fail fast and drop if either is false; no partial retry

traps.consequence: Counting only explicit outcomes misses implicit errors after run exhaustion; final attempt count wrong
traps.guard: Count all attempts including those after outcomes exhausted; implicit errors are still attempts

input_shape: lists of packet lengths and run-length-encoded outcomes; bounds: packets ≤200k, outcomes ≤200k runs, credit_cap ≤10^30, level_cap ≤60, max_retries ≤10^18
output_shape: dict with 'packets' (list of status, retries, spins, yields) and 'telemetry' dict (sent, dropped, errors, invalid, attempts, spins, yields, final_level, final_credits)
invariants: Congestion level stays in [0, level_cap]; credit balance in [0, credit_cap]
Each outcome run item consumes exactly one attempt; a packet may consume multiple outcomes if retried
Cost = min(2^old_level, spin_limit) grows exponentially up to level_cap, then plateaus
max_scale: 200,000 packets; 200,000 outcome runs with up to 10^18 items per run; credit_cap 10^30
